label: r4c5
name: LN transpose mb16 lr3e-3 headLN
hypothesis: Adds per-cell LayerNorm to the head's pre-activation on top of mb16 + lr 3e-3. Removing LayerNorm gave 0, so this world has a scale deviation, and the head is the one remaining un-normalised layer. Normalising it could make the logits better conditioned. A score of 0.94 or more supports it. A score under 0.88 means the head norm removes useful magnitude information.
